verdict.rationale: Klaviyo is an email platform, so separating transactional from marketing sending is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows event-triggered flows that send branded notifications (docs-17) and AI order-status updates (docs-26). None of it documents transactional templates kept apart from marketing, suppression rules that let a receipt reach an unsubscribed contact, or separate sending reputation. These are adjacent features, not the capability itself.
